newsitem.title: USA: Charter Power sees meeting Q2 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Charter Power sees meeting Q2 estimates.

text.p: Charter Power Systems Inc, a producer and marketer of electrical power storage and conversion products used in telecommunications, computers and office equipment, said it expects to meet analysts' expectations in its second quarter.
According to First Call, the analysts' mean estimate for that quarter, ending July 7, is $0.70 per share. In the prior year's second quarter, the company posted $0.40 per share.
The company also said that its shareholders approved a change in its name to C&D Technologies Inc.
